Michigan has more restaurants within a 10-minute walk of campus than Michigan State, Wayne State and Western Michigan combined.

Every Michigan university with 10,000+ students:

1. Michigan: 224
2. Michigan State: 84
3. Wayne State: 59
4. Western Michigan: 27
5. Oakland: 21
6. Central Michigan: 20
7. Ferris State: 16
8. Eastern Michigan: 13
9. Grand Valley State: 8

Places to eat within half a mile of each campus's center, using Overture Maps listings.

Look up any campus, with the closest places first: https://www.savorscout.net/campus/mi
